headers_left_credential_one: Leaves out the header {names}, since keys and passwords aren't carried over.
headers_left_credential_other: Leaves out the headers {names}, since keys and passwords aren't carried over.
headers_left_protocol_one: Leaves out the header {names}, since it's sent anyway.
headers_left_protocol_other: Leaves out the headers {names}, since they're sent anyway.
headers_left_unsupported_one: Leaves out the header {names}, since this kind of provider sends no extra headers.
headers_left_unsupported_other: Leaves out the headers {names}, since this kind of provider sends no extra headers.
headers_left_unsafe_one: Leaves out the header {names}, since its value can't be kept as written.
headers_left_unsafe_other: Leaves out the headers {names}, since their values can't be kept as written.
unrecognized: This doesn't look like a provider's settings. Paste an alias, export lines, a settings.json, a curl command or a provider's JSON.
invalid_json: This looks like JSON but couldn't be read. Check that all of it was pasted.
line_unused: Line {line} isn't an alias, a variable or a claude command, so it isn't used.
not_claude_alias: The alias {name} doesn't start Claude Code, so it isn't used.
not_claude_line: Line {line} doesn't start Claude Code, so it isn't used.
not_claude: This command doesn't start Claude Code, so it isn't used.
no_gateway_alias: {name} has no gateway address, so Claude Code signs in on its own there and there's nothing to add.
no_gateway_line: Line {line} has no gateway address, so Claude Code signs in on its own there and there's nothing to add.
no_gateway: There's no gateway address in it, so Claude Code would sign in on its own and there's nothing to add.
url_shell_alias: {name}'s address comes from the shell, so it can't be read here. Paste the address itself.
url_shell_line: The address on line {line} comes from the shell, so it can't be read here. Paste the address itself.
url_shell: The address comes from the shell, so it can't be read here. Paste the address itself.
url_user_alias: {name}'s address includes a user name or password, so it isn't used. Paste it without them.
url_user_line: The address on line {line} includes a user name or password, so it isn't used. Paste it without them.
url_user: The address includes a user name or password, so it isn't used. Paste it without them.
url_query_alias: {name}'s address has a part after ? or #, which can hold a key, so it isn't used. Paste the address without it.
url_query_line: The address on line {line} has a part after ? or #, which can hold a key, so it isn't used. Paste the address without it.
url_query: The address has a part after ? or #, which can hold a key, so it isn't used. Paste the address without it.
args_left_out: The words after claude aren't carried over, since they may hold a key. Add them under Advanced if you need them.
header_unreadable: A header with an unusual name isn't carried over. Add it under Advanced if you need it.
key_shell: The key comes from the shell, so it's left out. Paste the key itself on the next step.
no_key: No key was found. Type it on the next step.
key_helper: This settings.json gets its key by running a command, which can't be read here. Paste the key itself on the next step.
curl_path: {name} isn't a path Persona knows, so the whole URL is used as the address. Check it on the next step.
cindy_kind: This is one of the built-in providers, not a custom one. Pick it from the list instead and paste its key.
cindy_auth_oauth: This provider signs in with an account, which can't be added by pasting.
cindy_auth_none: This provider doesn't use a key.
cindy_auth: This provider signs in with {name}, which can't be added by pasting.
cindy_endpoint: Its {name} address isn't added, since a provider here has one address.
cindy_auth_unknown: This provider signs in a way that can't be added by pasting.
cindy_endpoint_unknown: One of its addresses isn't added, since Persona has no such kind of provider.
drafts_limit: Only the first {max} were read. The rest were left out.
other_line: Something on line {line} couldn't be used.
other: Part of it couldn't be used.
link_invalid_at: This import link is damaged or incomplete (at {name}). Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
link_invalid: This import link is damaged or incomplete. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
link_version: This import link uses format version {name}, which Persona can't read yet.
link_version_unknown: This import link uses a format version Persona can't read yet.
link_too_long: This import link is longer than an import link can be.
link_field: This import link has a field Persona doesn't know ({name}), so nothing from it was used.
link_field_unknown: This import link has a field Persona doesn't know, so nothing from it was used.
cindy_request_path: Its endpoint uses a request path of its own, which Persona can't set, so it works only if the gateway also answers at the usual path.
